import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Analysis in Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Top 10 Dog Breeds
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', 10)
bars1 = ax1.barh(range(len(breed_counts)), breed_counts.values, color=colors)
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(breed_counts)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(breed_counts.index)
ax1.invert_yaxis()
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs')
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Most Popular Dog Breeds', fontweight='bold')
for i, v in enumerate(breed_counts.values):
    ax1.text(v + 50, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=9)

# Plot 2: Dog Age Distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
# Filter out missing values and get age distribution
age_data = df[df['AlterVHundNum'].notna()]['AlterVHundNum']
sns.histplot(age_data, bins=20, kde=True, ax=ax2, color='steelblue', edgecolor='white')
ax2.set_xlabel('Dog Age (Years)')
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax2.set_title('Distribution of Dog Ages', fontweight='bold')
ax2.axvline(age_data.mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', label=f'Mean: {age_data.mean():.1f} years')
ax2.legend()

# Plot 3: Dogs by District (Kreis)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
district_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors3 = sns.color_palette('coolwarm', len(district_counts))
bars3 = ax3.barh(district_counts.index, district_counts.values, color=colors3)
ax3.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs')
ax3.set_title('Dog Registrations by District', fontweight='bold')

# Plot 4: Owner Age vs Dog Gender Distribution
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
# Create a cross-tabulation of owner age groups and dog gender
gender_age = pd.crosstab(df['AlterV10Lang'], df['SexHundLang'])
# Sort by the order defined in the data
age_order = df.sort_values('AlterV10Sort')['AlterV10Lang'].unique()
gender_age = gender_age.reindex([a for a in age_order if a in gender_age.index])

x = range(len(gender_age))
width = 0.35
if 'männlich' in gender_age.columns:
    ax4.bar([i - width/2 for i in x], gender_age['männlich'], width, label='Male Dogs', color='#3498db')
if 'weiblich' in gender_age.columns:
    ax4.bar([i + width/2 for i in x], gender_age['weiblich'], width, label='Female Dogs', color='#e74c3c')

ax4.set_xlabel('Owner Age Group')
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs')
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution by Owner Age Group', fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xticks(x)
ax4.set_xticklabels(gender_age.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax4.legend()

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
